answer: Because the lagoon history dates every edge, the reef audit rejects a connection created in the same window, so a farm cannot manufacture endorsements on demand. That makes last-minute recruitment useless, as the thread edge has to exist before the case does. Attestation is only accepted from an identity holding a verified edge to the author, and edges need 4 epochs of prior interaction to count. Honest users pay that once, farms 11 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
